scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['package-lock.json', 'yarn.lock'].forEach(f => { try { fs.unlinkSync(f) } catch {} });"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.start: pnpm run docker:build && pnpm run docker:up
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run docker:build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d
scripts.validate: pnpm run validate:workspace && pnpm run validate:env
